user.title: Helix Cultivate — Environment Setup
user.description: Choose how your growing environment is set up. Coordinated manages both your primary grow space and the outer room it sits in (the conditioning room) to pre-treat your air. Standalone only manages the climate directly inside the grow space.

data_description.topology: Coordinated pre-conditions supply air through a dedicated conditioning room before it enters the grow space. Standalone reads and controls the grow space directly.
data_description.primary_temp_sensor: The main temperature sensor inside your primary grow space canopy zone.
data_description.primary_humidity_sensor: The main relative humidity sensor inside your primary grow space canopy zone.

zone1_devices.title: Helix Cultivate — Conditioning Room Appliances
zone1_devices.description: Map optional conditioning room (Zone 1) climate appliances. Leave fields blank if not applicable.

data.zone1_is_reverse_cycle: This unit is a Reverse-Cycle Heat Pump
data.zone1_heater: Zone 1 Heater (or Backup Heater if Reverse-Cycle)

data_description.zone1_is_reverse_cycle: Check if your Air Conditioner can also heat. The Heater field becomes a backup / staging heater when this is enabled.
data_description.zone1_backup_heater_threshold_c: Only active when the AC is a Reverse-Cycle unit. The backup heater stages on when outdoor temperature falls below this value.

zone2_devices.title: Helix Cultivate — Grow Space Appliances & Extra Sensors
zone2_devices.description: Map optional grow space (Zone 2) climate appliances and additional canopy sensor pairs. Leave fields blank if not applicable.

data.zone2_is_reverse_cycle: This unit is a Reverse-Cycle Heat Pump

data_description.upper_canopy_temp_sensor: Optional. If mapped, overrides the primary sensor for upper-canopy temperature readings.
data_description.upper_canopy_humidity_sensor: Optional. If mapped, overrides the primary sensor for upper-canopy humidity readings.
data_description.mid_canopy_temp_sensor: Optional. Mid-canopy temperature sensor for stratification detection.
data_description.mid_canopy_humidity_sensor: Optional. Mid-canopy humidity sensor for stratification detection.
data_description.lower_canopy_temp_sensor: Optional. Lower-canopy temperature sensor for stratification detection.
data_description.lower_canopy_humidity_sensor: Optional. Lower-canopy humidity sensor for stratification detection.

fan_matrix.title: Helix Cultivate — Circulation Fan Matrix
fan_matrix.description: Assign up to 4 fan or switch entities per canopy tier. Slots left blank are ignored at runtime.

data_description.fan_control_mode: PWM 10-Step runs in 10% increments; Continuous allows 0–100%; Bang-Bang uses on/off relay.
data_description.breeze_variance: The fan speed will randomly deviate ±this percentage from the base speed at 8–25 second intervals.

lighting.title: Helix Cultivate — Grow Lighting
lighting.description: Map the grow light and configure dimming, sunrise/sunset ramps, DLI tracking, and time-lapse camera.

data_description.sunrise_ramp_min: Duration of the gradual sunrise and sunset intensity ramp.
data_description.dli_sensor: Optional. If mapped, the integration calculates cumulative DLI and can extend photoperiod to compensate for dimming.
data_description.grow_camera: Optional. If mapped, a snapshot is triggered 10 minutes before lights-out each day.

safety_params.title: Helix Cultivate — Safety & Control Parameters
safety_params.description: Configure control algorithm, safety cutoffs, anti-short-cycle, and leaf temperature offset.

data_description.control_algorithm: Bang-Bang uses deadband hysteresis; True PID uses Proportional-Integral-Derivative control for variable devices.
data_description.heater_cutoff_c: Zone 1 heater is killed immediately if canopy temperature exceeds this threshold.
data_description.thermal_runaway_c: Grow light dims to 0% and exhaust is forced to 100% if canopy temperature exceeds this threshold.
data_description.anti_short_cycle_min: Minimum dwell time between compressor restarts (dehumidifiers, AC units).
data_description.leaf_temp_offset_c: Applied to canopy dry-bulb temperature for accurate Leaf VPD calculation. Typically -2.5°C.
data_description.exhaust_min_pct: Exhaust fan will never go below this percentage to maintain negative pressure.

energy.title: Helix Cultivate — Energy & Cost Tracking
energy.description: Enter your electricity rate to enable cycle cost tracking.

stage_setup.title: Helix Cultivate — Grow Stage & Recipe
stage_setup.description: Configure the initial grow stage, progression mode, and optional strain recipe file.

data.recipe_file: Strain Recipe File (filename in recipes/ folder)

data_description.progression_mode: Manual: stage is locked until you change it. Timeframe Managed: auto-advances on elapsed days.
data_description.smooth_glides: When enabled, VPD/Temp/RH targets are linearly interpolated day-by-day across stage durations rather than hard-stepping.
data_description.recipe_file: Optional YAML filename (e.g. my_strain.yaml) inside the recipes/ folder. Leave blank to use built-in defaults.

conditioning_room_no_lung_sensors.title: Conditioning Room Has No Sensors
conditioning_room_no_lung_sensors.description: The Conditioning Room module is enabled but no lung-room temperature or humidity sensors are mapped. Map both sensors in Settings > Hardware Mapping, or disable the Conditioning Room module.

vpd_range_implausible.title: Implausible VPD Range Configured
vpd_range_implausible.description: One or more grow stages have a day VPD range where the maximum is lower than the minimum, or exceeds 4.0 kPa. Review your stage profiles in the Plant Cycle tab or imported recipe.

backup_heater_no_entity.title: Backup Heater Threshold Set Without an Entity
backup_heater_no_entity.description: A Zone 1 backup heater outdoor-temperature threshold is configured, but no backup heater (or primary heater acting as backup) entity is mapped. Map a heater entity in Settings > Hardware Mapping, or set the threshold to 0 to disable this feature.

drying_unlocked_no_sensor.title: Drying Zone Unlocked Without Sensors
drying_unlocked_no_sensor.description: The drying zone custom profile is unlocked, but the drying temperature or humidity sensor is not mapped. Custom drying control requires both sensors — map them in Settings > Hardware Mapping, or re-lock the drying zone to use the fixed 60/60 cure profile.
